jobs.prompt: First-person view at eye height, one continuous steady walk. The camera walks forward down the short corridor and straight through the open walnut-lined doorway at its end into a calm bedroom, and as it passes through the doorway it begins a smooth, gentle curve to the RIGHT across the room toward the window wall: the end of the bed with white linen and a rust throw slides in from the right edge, the tall window with sheer linen curtains and a small white vase on the sill comes ahead and settles right of centre, and the plain warm-white plaster wall fills the left, arriving exactly on the last frame. No pause, no zoom, no backward motion, never a sideways slide, no fast spin. Every wall, object and floor plank keeps its place, size and shape; nothing new appears on the walls; no other doors, openings, wardrobes or furniture than the frames show. Soft daylight, exposure locked. No people, no hands.
